answer: Written in a comparative analysis, benchmarks emphasized register, it stays short. The design leans on optimistic execution with fraud proof windows. Each submission hangs on the nebula of a task receipt, and the signal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the juniper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
